Description
Accurately and efficiently measure wire crimp pull forces up to 200 lbF [1 kN] with the WT-205M motorized pull tester. This portable and customizable tester meets UL, ISO, ASTM, SAE, and MIL standards for both destructive and non-destructive testing.
Perform pull-to-break, pull-to-load, or load-hold tests per UL 486A/B requirements. Programmable pass/fail limits with visual and audio alerts ensure easy identification of non-conforming samples.
The standard terminal fixture fits wire sizes up to AWG 3 (0.25 in [6.3 mm]), while a self-tightening wedge grip secures the free end. Optional interchangeable grips accommodate a variety of materials—samples can be sent to Mark-10 for grip recommendations.
Store up to 2,000 test readings with date/time stamps. Export data via USB, RS-232, Mitutoyo (Digimatic), or analog outputs. Auto-reverse, peak capture, and auto-zero functions enhance test efficiency. The Profiles feature allows quick setup recall.
Includes MESUR® Lite software for data acquisition and Excel export.
Features
Measures real-time and peak force values
Selectable test speed, w/high speed approach and reverse
Auto-reverse at sample break or load
USB, RS-232, Mitutoyo (Digimatic), and analog outputs
Automatic reverse / output / data storage / zeroing upon sample break helps automate testing processes
2,000-point data memory with statistics, output, and date and time stamp (date and time stamp is optional)
Password protection prevents unauthorized changes
Pass / fail indicators, audio alerts, and outputs
Save and recall up to 500 profiles for various test requirements (optional function)
Pull to a specified load or maintain load for a specified period of time, as per UL 486A/B (optional functions)
Date / time stamp for all saved data (optional function)

Optional Functions
Any of these optional functions may be purchased at time of order or may be enabled in the field at a later date through a simple activation process. A complete options package is also available, including all of the listed features at a discounted price. The tester is shipped in Demo Mode, during which time all available functions are enabled for 160 hours of operation.

FAQs
 Can JLW help me configure a testing system for my application?
 Yes, JLW can give you personalized recommendations based on your application. Our product specialists can help you compare options, understand capabilities, select appropriate fixtures and attachments, and ensure you purchase the right equipment for your needs. 
 Does JLW offer calibration services?
 Yes, JLW has a calibration lab that offers on-site and in-house services. We make significant, continual investments in calibration equipment and technician training to maintain rapid turnaround times, while providing the highest quality calibration services. 
 Where does JLW ship?
 JLW ships nationally and internationally. Customers ordering from outside the United States are responsible for covering all fees imposed during or after shipping (tariffs, taxes, etc.).
